Question: Assalam o Alaiqum! With due respect I want to know the meaning of girl name "Hudaibia". Because I would like to name my daughter Hudaibia, but I am not sure of the meaning. Please reply me as soon as possible and also suggest me some names if hudaibia is not permissible. I shall be very thankful to you. Answer ID: 20577 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 682/473/L=1431) "Hudaibia" is the name of a well, there is a village adjacent to it which is famous by the same name. This village is situated at a distance of 9 miles from Makkah. Hudaibia name may be kept but it is not suitable. It is better to choose one of the names of the wives of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ), his daughters or sahabiyat for your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
